reason: The tool duration never reaches NAc: execute_and_learn measures exec_elapsed but no caller passes record_outcome's elapsed_s, so no energy cost is booked and every tool_result link learns a 0.0 s delay. The fix is the duration as a host world-time field of B2's settle receipt (#1150), wired in runtime/tool_dispatch.py, which is fenced for the loop phase 2 / B2 lane until A-post. Robots keep today's behaviour until then, pinned by tests/unit/test_world_clock_a_pre.py::test_wc5_execute_and_learn_books_no_energy_cost_today; the wiring PR replaces that pin with G-tool-duration, landed red (docs/plans/world_clock_a_pre.md, PR 0's corrections).
